artwork: Original Microsoft Plus! Dancer footage and transparency mattes. Copyright Microsoft Corporation.
enhancement: Each 320x240 frame enlarged 4x with Real-ESRGAN (realesr-general-x4v3, BSD-3-Clause, https://github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN), then reduced to 2x. Mattes enlarged 2x with bicubic filtering. Empty rows above the dancer are cropped.
format: <id>.mp4: H.264, color in the left half and the grayscale alpha matte in the right half, 640 pixels wide each, original 30 fps and full duration. <id>.png: 192x192 portrait with alpha. <id>-moves.png: one 64x64 card per move, left to right in file order.
moves: Move boundaries, the join table and frame rates come from the SegmentInfo, ConnectionTable and FrameRates tags recorded in Metadata.json.
